description: Digital oscillator and LFO on frequency and phase modulation, with three extra voices that share its settings and have their own pitch, gate, level and output

params.text: Picks whether the module runs at audio rate as an oscillator or at low frequency as an LFO
Sets the range of the TUNE knob: FINE is a semitone up and down, COARSE is an octave up and down, SEMI is an octave up and down quantized to semitones
Offsets the V/OCT input over the range set by the tune mode switch
Offsets the V/OCT input three octaves up and down, and modulating it produces arpeggios
Sets the balance of even and odd harmonics in the main oscillator: fully counter-clockwise gives a square, fully clockwise a saw
Sets the number of harmonics in the main oscillator, from the bare fundamental to the full wave, much like a lowpass filter
Sets the level of white noise added to the mix, which suits percussive sounds
Sets the frequency of the FM modulator, over the range set by the RATIO and FREE switch
Sets how much the modulator frequency-modulates the main oscillator
Applies a fold-like distortion to the phase of the main oscillator, which sounds like overtones added to the tone
Transforms the phase of the main oscillator in a logarithmic or exponential way, for a thinner or fatter sound
Changes the amplitude of the phase of the main oscillator, which sounds like hard clipping
Adds positive feedback to the phase of the main oscillator, for a resonating sound
Sets how far the parameters can move when a gate arrives, and at the maximum they can move from minimum to maximum
Sets how long the parameters stay away from their set values after a gate: a low setting snaps back for percussive sounds, and at the maximum they stay put until the next gate sets a new random state
Picks how the modulator frequency is chosen: RATIO restricts it to factors of the main frequency, from a half to eight times it, and FREE allows any frequency in that range
Sets how much the signal at the FM input frequency-modulates the main oscillator
Sets the maximum rate at which the pitch follows a change of the V/OCT input
SKIPGATE leaves the glide out when the pitch changes at the same moment as the gate, ALWAYS applies the glide to every pitch change
Picks the wave of the modulator: SAW for an edgier result, SINE for softer modulation
Offsets the pitch of that extra voice
Sets how much of that extra voice reaches the OUT jack of the main voice
Balances the sound of the oscillator: counter-clockwise the highs are removed and the lows enhanced
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the main voice, 1V per octave, where 0V is a C1
A gate that drives the chaos section of the main voice, and whose timing the SKIPGATE glide mode uses
An external signal that frequency-modulates the main oscillator, scaled by the EXT.FM knob
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number
A gate for that extra voice, which has a chaos engine of its own
Sets the pitch of that extra voice, 1V per octave

outputs.text: The mixed waves and noise of the main voice, with the extra voices added at the level set by their LEVEL knobs
The audio of that extra voice, at full level whatever its LEVEL knob is set to

notes: an extra voice runs only while its own output or one of its own inputs is patched.
a modulation input does nothing until its slot has been assigned: press that slot's button, then move the knob or switch the slot should change
